title: UI Cheat Sheet
desc: Quick reference for navigation and common actions.
lede: A fast reference for getting around Studio.
body:
At a glance
  • Main navigation map.
  • Common actions.
  • Where key features live.

Navigation map

  • Library → your projects.
  • Project → Chapters, Characters, Assemblies, Backups.
  • Voice Lab → build and manage voices.
  • Queue → monitor jobs.
  • Settings → defaults, engines, API.

Common actions

  • Create a project; add a chapter (paste or upload).
  • Build/assign a voice; generate; review and fix lines.
  • Assemble to M4B/MP3.
Note — Detailed walkthroughs live in the User Guide.
